justification: Both depict a single upright figure wearing a headdress, but beyond that the subject matter diverges completely: A is a human male in profile holding a staff/bow, while B is a composite bird-headed, winged anthropomorphic being with elaborate feathered wings and skirt. There is no shared specific iconographic motif, relationship, or compositional arrangement, and the rendering conventions (naturalistic relief vs. flat schematic polychrome figure) are entirely different.
